title: Support in a ball and the convex hull property (Simon 6.1–6.2)
statement: Assume (GF). Then SupportInBall holds (if n ≥ 1, R ≥ 0, V has L¹_loc generalized mean curvature H in U = ℝ^{n+ℓ} ∖ B_R(ξ) with n^{-1}|H(x)·(x − ξ)| < 1 for μ_V-a.e. x ∈ U, and spt V is compact, then spt V ⊆ B_R(ξ)), and ConvexHullProperty holds (if n ≥ 1, K is compact, spt V is compact and V is stationary in ℝ^{n+ℓ} ∖ K, then spt V ⊆ conv K).
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → SupportInBall ∧ ConvexHullProperty
